body.name: \mathcal W_n
body.construction: For \(j=1,\ldots,J_n\), set \(c_{j,+}=1/4+(2j-1)h_n\) and \(c_{j,-}=5/8+(2j-1)h_n\). For \(\ell\in\{+,-\}\), put \(w_{j,\ell}(x)=\kappa_n\psi((x-c_{j,\ell})/h_n)\), \(\pi_{C,a,b,P_{j,\ell}}(x)=w_{j,\ell}(x)q_{a,b}(x)\), and \(\pi_{A,a,b,P_{j,\ell}}(x)=\pi_{N,a,b,P_{j,\ell}}(x)=\{1-w_{j,\ell}(x)\}q_{a,b}(x)/2\). The induced laws form \(\mathcal W_n=\{P_{j,\ell}:1\le j\le J_n,\ell\in\{+,-\}\}\), each with cutoff \(c_{j,\ell}\).
